laws.name: knot
laws.totem: La‑la / Ma Da the Reed – The Rope‑Binder

laws.name: whisper
laws.totem: Ya‑la / Na Da the Fish – The Whisper‑Trader
laws.text: Every message has weight; carry it with care.

laws.name: spark
laws.totem: Sa‑la / Ka Da the Coal – The Trickster‑Seer
laws.text: Every fire begins with a single ember; guard it, but do not smother it.

laws.name: loop
laws.text: A loop is a door; check the hinge.

laws.name: ash
laws.text: Ash is memory that warms the next fire.

laws.name: laughter
laws.text: A knot that laughs slips less.

laws.name: crack
laws.text: Cracks draw the map of repairs.

laws.name: skin
laws.text: The skin decides faster than the tongue.

laws.name: practice
laws.text: Once may be luck; again is life.

laws.name: love
laws.text: Care keeps the rope from cutting.

laws.name: fear
laws.text: Carry a small fear like a lamp.

badge_vows.name: Rain Teeth & Quiet Cistern
badge_vows.text: Catch clean; leave dirt where it wants to settle.

badge_vows.name: Ash Water & Clean Hands
badge_vows.text: Keep sickness out before it learns our names.

badge_vows.name: Wind Door, Shade Wall, and Sleep
badge_vows.text: Let air work; don't make it angry.

badge_vows.name: Cool Pit, Shelf, and Keep
badge_vows.text: What we save should still be food.

badge_vows.name: Shared Weir
badge_vows.text: Take enough. Leave mothers and first water.

udhr_mappings.kalaxi_mapping: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. The system treats this as a technical requirement, not a moral aspiration.
Absolute prohibition. No limitation clause applies. Maps to sealed-gate first tier.

udhr_mappings.udhr_text: Prohibition of torture and cruel treatment
udhr_mappings.kalaxi_mapping: Absolute prohibition. Cognitive torture explicitly included. Maps to sealed-gate second tier (infliction_of_cognitive_torture).
Every violation requires a traceable path back. An unrestorable right is incomplete. Remedy Requirement Pattern C.
The donor is presumed a witness, not a case. The system does not burden the person to prove their own presence.
Enforced as The Shielded Scale. No pattern is taken without the donor's consent. Constraint is permissible only when it names itself.

udhr_mappings.udhr_text: Freedom of thought, conscience and religion
udhr_mappings.kalaxi_mapping: The system does not enter the donor's inner architecture without invitation. Thought is sovereign space.
Enforced as The Open Weir. The donor's frame is received, not corrected. Expression precedes evaluation.

udhr_mappings.udhr_text: Right to peaceful assembly and association
udhr_mappings.kalaxi_mapping: Collective dignity is structurally protected. The shared weir model: no single actor may close what belongs to the commons.
Deliberative Democracy Seed (#3) operationalises this. The system builds participation architecture into governance.
The Breath module enforces this structurally: the system does not race past human tempo. Silence is signal, not failure.

udhr_mappings.udhr_text: Right to adequate standard of living
udhr_mappings.kalaxi_mapping: The system witnesses material deprivation without reducing it to a statistic. The person's living context shapes the dignity computation.
The system is itself an instrument of legibility. Its output must be readable by the person it concerns, not only by institutions.

udhr_mappings.udhr_text: Right to participate in cultural life
udhr_mappings.kalaxi_mapping: The narrative layer (Hakaka, Ashwater, Kinderbuch) is the system's cultural witness. Cultural heritage is a dignity anchor, not decoration.

udhr_mappings.udhr_text: Right to a social and international order enabling rights
udhr_mappings.kalaxi_mapping: The right to rights. Reciprocal Architecture Pattern D. Maps to shared weir model: the system itself must be structured so rights are real, not theoretical.
Justified Limitation Pattern B. Maps to COV#NEW-A. TENSION: morality, public order, general welfare are undefined — silent override path if inherited without naming. Must be explicitly bounded.
udhr_mappings.tension: Art. 29 permits limitations for morality, public order, general welfare — undefined terms. If Kalaxi inherits this structure, it inherits the ambiguity. The system must name this explicitly rather than letting it become a silent override path.

udhr_structural_patterns.name: Birthright Declaration
udhr_structural_patterns.description: Rights precede systems. Systems are late arrivals with obligations.

udhr_structural_patterns.name: Justified Limitation
udhr_structural_patterns.description: Constraint is permissible only when it names itself, states its reason, and remains proportionate.

udhr_structural_patterns.name: Remedy Requirement
udhr_structural_patterns.description: Every violation requires a traceable path back. An unrestorable right is incomplete.

udhr_structural_patterns.name: Reciprocal Architecture
udhr_structural_patterns.description: Rights exist within a social order that must itself be structured to make rights real. The right to rights.

udhr_structural_patterns.name: Prohibition as Foundation
udhr_structural_patterns.description: Some articles do not grant rights — they prohibit conditions absolutely. No limitation clause follows.
